claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nilutamide at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; it is a nonsteroidal androgen receptor antagonist whose only plausible cell-killing activity would be weak AR-dependent growth inhibition in AR-expressing prostate cancer lines, not a general cytotoxic effect.
